blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning can align visual generators with reward signals beyond their pretraining objectives, but existing score-function methods typically introduce stochasticity by perturbing the reverse denoising trajectory, leading to costly rollout-based optimization. We instead ask whether stochastic exploration can be introduced inside the generator while preserving its original sampler. Routing Policy Optimization (RPO) answers this question by turning attention routing into a stochastic exploration action. At a few selected denoising levels, each query block keeps its own block and samples further key blocks in proportion to the generator's native attention mass, or keeps dense attention. The sampled route perturbs the velocity of that transition, and a Gaussian likelihood around the dense velocity scores the perturbation with a score-function objective. RPO further uses a controlled two-rollout estimator: two rollouts share the same prompt, initial latent, routed denoising levels, and dense anchor layers, differing only in their sampled attention routes. Their reward difference provides an advantage signal for the routed transitions. Because the likelihood differentiates the dense velocity itself, the learned updates remain effective after routing is removed. At inference, RPO restores dense attention and retains the original deterministic sampler. Experiments on text-to-image and text-to-video generation show that RPO improves generation quality while achieving nearly 4x higher training efficiency than Flow-GRPO-style methods. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/rpo for visual results.
blocks.zh: 强化学习可以使视觉发电机与超越其前期训练目标的奖励信号相配合,但现有的分数功能方法通常通过扰动倒向去诺分道扬镳的轨迹来引入分色,导致代价高昂的以推出为基础的优化. 相反,我们询问是否可以在发电机内部引入有花样的勘探,同时保留其原始取样器。 Routing Political Observation(RPO)通过将注意力的去向化为有花样的探索行动来回答这个问题. 在少数选定的去诺化水平上,每个查询块会保持自己的块并按生成器的原生关注质量比例对更多的关键块进行取样,或者保持密集的注意. 被取样的路线扰动了这种过渡的速度,在密集速度周围的一种高斯概率以得分函数目标来给扰动打分. RPO还使用了受控的双滚出计数器:两个出计数器共享相同的即时,初始潜伏,路由去诺能水平,以及密集的锚地层,仅在被取样的注意路线上有所不同. 他们的奖励差异为路由过渡提供了优势信号. 由于概率会区分密度速度本身,所学的更新在去除路由后依然有效. 推断出,RPO恢复了密集的注意力并保留了原来的定型采样器. 关于文本到图像和文本到视频生成的实验表明,RPO提高了生成质量,同时实现了近4x高的培训效率,超过了Flow-GRPO风格的方法. 请在https://velox-world.com/rpo上查看我们的项目网页,了解视觉效果。

blocks.en:
Diffusion and flow models now generate high-quality images and videos from
natural-language prompts ( Shen et al., 2026b ; Li & Wang, 2026 ) . DDPM establishes stochastic reverse denoising, while
DDIM exposes a deterministic sampling path under the same training
objective ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021 ) . Flow matching and rectified flow
instead learn vector fields for continuous transport ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Esser et al., 2024 ) . In parallel, latent diffusion,
Diffusion Transformers, and video diffusion models make high-resolution
visual generation tractable at scale ( Rombach et al., 2021 ; Peebles & Xie, 2022 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Wan Team et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) .
Learned preference models then expose alignment objectives beyond likelihood
and reconstruction ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Kirstain et al., 2023 ; Ma et al., 2025 ) .

Online reinforcement learning can optimize these objectives, but its central
bottleneck is the policy. DDPO and DPOK treat stochastic denoising transitions
as actions ( Black et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2023 ) . Flow-GRPO and DanceGRPO extend
this construction to deterministic flow models by converting their ODE
samplers into stochastic SDEs ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Xue et al., 2025b ) . Temporal windows,
shared branches, and one-step updates reduce the resulting rollout cost ( Li et al., 2025a ; He et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ; He et al., 2026 ) , while dense credit and
regulated clipping improve how terminal rewards shape sampler transitions ( Deng et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . Forward-matching objectives
avoid reverse-trajectory likelihoods, but they also remove the explicit
sampled action ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Xue et al., 2025a ; Xu et al., 2026c ; Choi et al., 2026 ) . What
remains missing is an explicit, tractable policy that preserves the original
deterministic sampler for both image and video generators.

blocks.en:
Our key insight is that stochastic exploration need not perturb the denoising
trajectory. A diffusion transformer splits each latent into visual tokens, and
its attention layers already decide how much each token attends to the others. If we
group neighboring tokens into blocks, each query block can attend to a sampled
subset of key blocks instead of all of them as dense attention does. We call
this choice of visible key blocks a route . Sampling routes exposes a
stochastic action without adding a policy head or modifying the sampler. We
introduce Routing Policy Optimization (RPO), which samples attention
routes from the generator’s own attention mass at a few denoising levels. Each
sampled route perturbs the velocity of its transition, and a Gaussian
likelihood around the dense velocity scores this perturbation. This likelihood
supplies a score-function surrogate for the dense generator itself.

carries no gradient, and the likelihood differentiates the dense velocity. The
update therefore acts on the same velocity field that dense inference
evaluates. After training, we remove all masks and evaluate the updated
generator with dense attention and its original deterministic sampler. The
central empirical question is whether reward learned through temporary routing
transfers to the dense image or video generator used at inference.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Reward alignment methods for visual generators differ mainly in where the
learning signal enters the generator. We organize prior work along this axis,
from the sampler trajectory to the attention computation.
blocks.zh:
视相发电机的奖励校正方法主要在下述领域有所不同:
学习信号进入生成器。 我们沿着这一轴线组织先前的工作,
从采样器的轨迹到注意力的计算。

blocks.en:
DDPO and DPOK first treated stochastic denoising transitions as policy
actions ( Black et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2023 ) . Flow-GRPO and DanceGRPO carried
this view to flow matching and video by converting the deterministic sampler
into an SDE and estimating group-relative
advantages ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Xue et al., 2025b ) . Follow-up work lowers the cost of these
stochastic trajectories. Temporal windows, shared-prefix branches, and
one-step updates reduce the number or cost of stochastic
transitions ( Li et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025b ; He et al., 2026 ) . TempFlow-GRPO concentrates
stochasticity at designated branch points for temporal credit
assignment ( He et al., 2025 ) , and TAGRPO aligns trajectories that start
from identical initial noise ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Dense temporal and spatial credit
or regulated clipping further improve how a terminal reward shapes each
transition ( Deng et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . These methods
keep the action inside the sampler, so exploration still perturbs the reverse
trajectory.

A second family avoids sampler actions. Direct reward fine-tuning
backpropagates through differentiable image or video
rewards ( Clark et al., 2023 ; Prabhudesai et al., 2024 ) . For black-box rewards, DiffusionNFT, DGPO, and
advantage-weighted matching replace reverse-trajectory likelihoods with
forward-process or preference objectives ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Xue et al., 2025a ) .
Adjoint matching, ELBO surrogates, path-space value gradients, and velocity
matching pursue the same goal through native regression
targets ( Bergmeister et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026c ; Choi et al., 2026 ) . For few-step generators, a
hybrid scheme combines distribution matching, GRPO on stochastic intermediate
transitions, and reward backpropagation through the final
step ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . Offline preference optimization removes online rollouts
altogether, ranging from Diffusion-DPO to multidimensional and temporally dense
video preferences ( Wallace et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Wu et al., 2025b ) .
These objectives leave inference untouched, but they give up an explicit
sampled action. In contrast, RPO keeps a score-function policy with a
recorded action and places that action inside attention.

blocks.en:
Discrete policies already exist in visual generation. MaskGRPO, Mask-GRPO,
and MaskFocus optimize token corruption, unmasking, or mask schedules in
natively discrete image generators ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) .
Structured attention sparsity is also well studied, although mainly for
efficiency. Q/K-derived block gates and training-free compression expose
attention redundancy ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Xi et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) .
VSA, trainable dynamic routing, and hierarchical sparse attention learn such
sparsity inside image and video
generators ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Lv et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026a ) .
Reinforcement learning has also selected sparse-attention levels or
recomputation schedules for acceleration ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Aliev et al., 2026 ) . KVPO comes
closest to alignment. It explores through stochastic historical-key routing in
autoregressive video and scores branches with a velocity-energy
surrogate ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Other work optimizes attention allocation for
multimodal reasoning or routes preference credit through diffusion
attention ( Li et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026b ) . Dropout-GRPO samples Bernoulli masks to diversify
deterministic latent reasoning ( Jung, 2026 ) . Our
paired estimator also builds on common random numbers and group-relative
baselines ( Asmussen & Glynn, 2007 ; Shao et al., 2024 ) , and 2-GRPO shows that
two language-model rollouts can retain most of a larger group’s
performance ( Wu et al., 2025a ) . RPO combines these ingredients through a new
interface. Its action is a block route sampled from native attention mass
inside a bidirectional diffusion transformer, its Gaussian velocity likelihood
updates the dense generator, and the route disappears before inference.

blocks.en:
The generator is a diffusion transformer that splits each latent into M M visual tokens, one per spatial patch of an image or spatiotemporal patch of a
video. In every self-attention layer and head, each token emits a query, a
key, and a value vector. The attention weights of a query are a softmax over
its scaled inner products with the keys.
Dense attention lets every query attend to every key. Block-sparse attention
coarsens this pattern. It arranges the tokens in a sequence, cuts the sequence
into Q Q contiguous token blocks of B B tokens, and applies a binary
block mask μ ∈ { 0 , 1 } Q × Q \mu\in\{0,1\}^{Q\times Q} . A query token in block q q attends
only to the key tokens of blocks j j with μ q , j = 1 \mu_{q,j}=1 , and its softmax
renormalizes over those keys. We order the tokens along a locality-preserving
Gilbert curve, so each block is a compact image or video patch, and both
generators use B = 128 B=128 . We call the set of key blocks that query block q q keeps its route , and the choice of routes routing .
Sparse-attention methods choose routes to save computation. RPO instead
samples routes as its exploration action during training and restores dense
attention at inference.

Our experiments test whether reward learned through temporary routing transfers

score and DeQA-Score ( You et al., 2025 ) measure image quality, while
ImageReward ( Xu et al., 2023 ) , PickScore, and
UnifiedReward ( Wang et al., 2025b ) measure preference. During training, we
evaluate the dense model every 5 steps on 64 fixed validation prompts with a
28-step sampler.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
RPO places its policy action inside attention, and this design choice also
defines its current limits. First, the framework is confined to attention.
Its action is a mask over key-value blocks, so it requires a backbone that
computes attention. We have not yet generalized routing to other
architectures, where no attention mass exists to propose routes. Second, the
routing proposal and its likelihood are coarse. Each route logit averages the
attention mass of a whole block over every routed layer and head, which hides
token-level and layer-specific structure. Moreover, the velocity likelihood
treats the routed deviation as Gaussian, although a discrete route produces
it. A finer proposal and a likelihood that also credits the route choice
could give the policy a more faithful view of which blocks matter. Finally, RPO currently adapts to an existing
generator rather than shaping it. Co-designing the network architecture with
RPO is a promising direction for achieving both higher efficiency and
larger RL gains.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we addressed the cost of online reinforcement learning for
visual generators without perturbing their reverse denoising trajectories.
We introduced Routing Policy Optimization, a sampler-preserving method that
samples block-wise attention routes from the generator’s native attention
mass at a few selected denoising levels. A controlled pair holds the
non-routing generation context fixed, so its reward difference weights a
Gaussian velocity likelihood of the two recorded routed trajectories. Because
this likelihood updates the dense velocity field, inference removes the masks
and restores dense attention under the original deterministic sampler. Experiments on Stable Diffusion 3.5
and Wan2.2 demonstrate improved reward-aligned quality across text-to-image and
text-to-video generation while requiring substantially less training compute
than sampler-space baselines. By moving stochastic exploration from the
sampler into attention, RPO provides an efficient policy interface for
reward-aligned visual generation without altering the inference process.

blocks.en:
Two failure modes remain open. The first is a dense-gain fade. In some runs,
the dense-inference gain peaks and then decays, while the reward of the routed
training rollouts keeps rising. The generator then improves its routed
transitions faster than its dense ones. Centered routed steps keep the
rollouts near the dense path and reduce this split on Stable Diffusion 3.5,
but the mechanism is not fully isolated. The second is reward hacking against
the frozen preference model. This risk is general to online RL for generative
models and is not specific to RPO. Both failure modes suggest that a scalar
terminal reward is a coarse supervisor for a routed exploration action.
blocks.zh:

密集的推论会增加峰值,然后衰败,而路由的回报
培训的推广不断上升。 发电机会改进路由
转换速度比密度快。 居中路由步骤保留
在密集路径附近展开 并减少这种分裂 在稳定扩散3.5,
但机制并不完全孤立。 二是奖励黑客
冻结优惠模式。 这种风险一般是在线RL的基因风险
模型,并不针对RPO. 两种失败模式都表明
终端奖励是经过路由的勘探行动的粗糙监督。

blocks.en:
The velocity likelihood in Equation 5 is a surrogate
rather than the exact likelihood of the sampled route. It models the routed
deviation as an isotropic Gaussian around the dense velocity, whereas the true
deviation is the effect of a discrete route on the attention output. It also
omits the pathwise gradient of the generator through later denoising
transitions and through the frozen reward model. Finally, the width s t 2 s_{t}^{2} is re-estimated on every batch. As routing perturbs the generator less during
training, s t 2 s_{t}^{2} shrinks, so the same deviation produces a larger gradient.

blocks.en:
Two directions extend the method naturally. A likelihood that adds the
probability of the sampled route to the velocity term would also credit the
route choice itself, rather than only its effect on the dense velocity.
